source.label: Wizards event coverage, Vintage Championship 2015: Top 8 Decklists

notes.text: Players: 460 per the Wizards coverage page; the final standings and mtgtop8 have 484 rows, and a CoolStuffInc retrospective says 458.
Placings from the Wizards final standings (1 Kelly, 2 Greene, 3 Brophy, 4 Mastriano, 5-8 Herbig, Shay, Grudzina, Eberhart). No standings after the last Swiss round survive, so seeds are unknown.
Archetype names are MTGGoldfish's, for consistency across events.
Main deck of 61 cards as Wizards printed it; mtgtop8 has the same 61. Nothing in the list is plainly wrong (no repeated or doubled restricted card), so it is kept as printed.
